messages:
maria: Heads up — planning a mini-rootfs rebuild next Tue (03/31) to strip debug symbols, collapse a couple of intermediate layers, and add a cosign attestation step. Target: staging canary -> prod rollout. Need RBAC sign-off and KMS signing path validated. Minimal blast radius.

ashok: Do we have the KMS key name and who needs sign perms?

maria: Key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-v1. Plan: grant SignOnly to keystore-service@redwood-prod. Add 'image-signers' group for human approves. Sec, is that acceptable?

samir: Prefer not to grant broad project roles. Suggest: a dedicated service account with only `iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob` or the KMS CryptoKey Sign role scoped to this key. Also we should gate by a workflow (signed by the CI pipeline) so humans don't sign directly except via the group.

olivia: Need a rollback/runbook. If the canary fails, what's quick mitigation? Are any CVE patches included in this rebuild?

maria: Minimal runbook in the PR: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/minirootfs (short link). Rollback: revert image tag in the deployment, mark canary unhealthy -> rollout abort. CVE fixes: libssl upgrade + remove vulnerable helper binary. Nothing else exotic.

sec-oncall: For RBAC: we can allow `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`? No — too broad. Better: grant `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on the specific cryptoKey with condition on `resource.name` and a tag `rebuild=v1`. I'll paste a binding YAML.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-31T02:00Z pending 2 approvals

ashok: YAML snippet for IAM binding (draft):
```
- role: roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier
  members:
    - serviceAccount:keystore-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  condition:
    title: "rebuild-v1-only"
    expression: "resource.name.endsWith('/cryptoKeys/rebuild-v1')"
```

samir: Also ensure KMS audit logs for `cryptoKeys.*` are exported to sec-log cluster. Alert if sign events occur outside the scheduled window or from unexpected callers.

olivia: I'll own canary monitoring and alerting. Who's validating cosign attestations and SBOM diffs? Need automated verification step in deploy pipeline.

maria: cosign sign command (CI will run):
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-v1 <image>
```
verify:
```
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-sign/cryptoKeys/rebuild-v1 <image>
```
We also generate a signed SBOM and run `syft` diff against previous baseline.

sec-oncall: Add post-deploy audit checklist: 1) KMS audit log entries for sign events, 2) cosign verification succeeded with timestamp, 3) SBOM diff sanity, 4) runtime security checks (seccomp profile, dropped capabilities). Capture all into incident channel if any mismatch.

ashok: One more Q: will UID/GID or filesystem layout change such that init containers / PV mounts break? If so we need an init `chown` step or adjust deployment perms.

samir: Good catch — if base image changes ownership we should add an init container to `chown -R` on startup for affected volumes. Add that to runbook and tests.

olivia: :thumbsup: I'll be on-call for the window and will add dashboard widgets (latency, error-rate, container restarts, SBOM drift). Retention for KMS audit logs should be forced to 90d for now.

maria: Thanks — next steps: @ashok please open IAM PR with the conditional binding, @samir add alert policy and audit export config, @olivia add monitoring widgets + approve when ready. I'll add cosign verification to the pipeline and the SBOM diff job. Tag me when PRs are up.

deploy-bot: approval status: required=2, current=1 (olivia)

ashok: I'll draft the IAM PR this afternoon and paste the full policy here for review.

maria: Perfect — circle back here once PRs are posted. If anything unexpected happens during canary, escalate to #incidents and page sec-oncall.
